thread:
ela (Product Design): quick gut check on the bulk role-change modal. Figma: https://go.fig/redwood/bulk-role. main tensions: inline vs top summary errors, required marker visibility, and whether to use typed confirm for destructive changes. thoughts?
ton y (PM): goal is low friction but safe. small batches shouldn't need typed confirm. large batches might.
mira (Eng): typed confirm is cheap to add but causes mobile layout issues. if we do typed confirm, disable paste and debounce to avoid accidental matches. also server-side verify after client confirm.
sue (A11y): accessibility notes: asterisk alone is not sufficient. include sr-only "required" text and ensure error summary is focusable with role="alert". when using typed confirm, announce step changes via aria-live. color can't be the only error cue.
dia (Design): proposal: inline errors for row fixes + compact summary bar that links into rows. For destructive: stepper only for >30 items or org policy. default: undo toast (5m) + clear impact copy.
ops-bot: telemetry: emit bulk_open, bulk_error_shown, bulk_confirm_attempt, bulk_confirm_success, bulk_undo_used. include affected_count and device_type.
ela (Product Design): next steps: dia will update mocks with stepper variant and inline-error states; mira to estimate effort and mobile testing; sue to run quick a11y checklist; ops-bot to create telemetry ticket. follow-up in 48h. :thumbsup:
